# Disagreement Log — GTH_069

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 69
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 69 | "persecuted in their heart" | "persecuted within their hearts" | "suffered inwardly" | Interior persecution: literal vs. paraphrastic |
| 2 | 69 | "the belly of the one who desires" | "the stomach of him who desires" | "the one who craves will have their fill" | *koilia* + *epithymia*: body part + desire |

**Total disagreements: 2**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA preserves literal "in their heart" and "belly of the one who desires" to maintain both physical and spiritual registers.
